_doc: The CC0 material library (UPDATE_05 section 1, T-088; docs/ART_BIBLE.md section 3). MaterialLibrary.get_mat(key) builds one shared ShaderMaterial (assets/materials/shaders/surface_pbr.gdshader) per key from `library` and caches it. set = assets/third_party/<set>/textures/<id>_{albedo,normal,orm[,height]}.png; tile_m = metres one tile covers (uv_scale = 1 / tile_m, per axis when `tile_xyz` is given); tint multiplies the albedo; rough = [min, max] clamp on the ORM's roughness; grime / wetness / frost are the shared wear parameters (0..1); frost_height = world y the frost starts above (-1000 = everywhere); triplanar false = the mesh's own UVs (props). `generator` maps the procedural Mats keys (gravelight/world/materials.gd, what gen_map0N.gd and Props call) to library keys: Mats.get_mat() hands out the library material for a key in `enabled` while use_library is true, so the environment builder switches Map 0 over one key at a time by adding to `enabled` and re-running gen_map00. Note for consumers that cast Mats.get_mat() to StandardMaterial3D (landscape.gd reads the snow's albedo_texture): a library material is a ShaderMaterial; read MaterialLibrary.texture(key, 'albedo') instead.

floorboards.note: the inn's floors; boards run along X (the taproom's long axis)

planks.note: the stable's walls, fences, the woodshed

plaster.note: the inn's walls inside and out

plaster_upper.note: the upper storey and the guest rooms

fieldstone.note: the yard wall, the hearth, the cellar's foundation

shingles.note: the roofs: weathered wood shakes with the snow load as frost

iron.note: brackets, hinges, the cage's bars, the drums

ice.note: the stream, the trough, the ice cellar

frozen_mud.note: the roads' ruts, the yard track

dirt.note: the stable floor, the cellar's earth
